title: Princess Airfryer — Double Basket 2 × 4 L
description: Family-size double-basket air fryer that uses hot-air circulation and very little oil for healthier meals. Two independent 4 L drawers let you cook two dishes at once, with eight preset programs and adjustable temperature from 80 °C to 220 °C. 2400 W with auto-off timer. One of Europris' most talked-about kitchen appliances of the season.

title: Naxos Corner Sofa Group — Dark Grey
description: Hand-woven artificial rattan corner sofa group with a powder-coated steel frame, marketed by Europris as their most popular sofa group. Includes thick water-repellent polyester cushions and a dining table with tempered glass top. The corner sofa can be assembled in two directions to fit any patio. Sofa: 241 × 176 × 72 cm, table: 145 × 80 × 72 cm.

title: Oval Trampoline — 3 × 4.6 m with Safety Net
description: Mid-size oval garden trampoline (3 × 4.6 m) with a 1.5 mm double-galvanised steel frame and 56 springs for a generous, even bounce. Includes safety net and padding. CE-marked and TÜV-tested with a 5-year warranty against rust and frame breakage. Among Europris' best-selling outdoor leisure items.

title: Bestway Inflatable Pool — Round 183 cm / 940 L
description: Round inflatable family pool from Bestway with a durable laminated PVC construction. Holds 940 litres at full capacity with a diameter of 183 cm. No filter pump required for short, casual use — ideal for cooling off on hot summer days. A consistent seasonal bestseller at Europris.

title: Energy+ Steam Iron — 2200 W
description: Powerful 2200 W steam iron with a ceramic soleplate that glides smoothly across all fabrics. Features dry ironing, variable steam, steam burst, spray and self-clean. Anti-calcium and anti-drip protection extend the life of the iron and keep clothes spotless. 400 ml water tank and 3 m cord.

title: Miami Lounge Chair with Footrest
description: Outdoor lounge chair with matching footrest from the popular Miami series. Sturdy aluminium frame with comfortable cushions designed for long, lazy afternoons in the garden. Lightweight, weather-resistant and easy to move around. Part of Europris' top-selling Miami outdoor collection.

title: Lyngby Lounge Set — 5-piece
description: Five-piece outdoor lounge set in natural-look artificial rattan, including chairs, footstool and table. Comfortable cushions and a relaxed Scandinavian aesthetic make it a feature on this year's Europris campaign list (save 2000 kr). Easy to combine with other pieces from the Lyngby series.

title: Flora Stacking Chair — Plastic
description: Lightweight plastic stacking chair from the Flora range, perfect for terraces, balconies and extra seating. Stacks compactly when not in use and resists rain and UV. Frequently featured on Europris' weekly bestseller list at the campaign price of 199 kr (down from 399 kr).

title: Keter Kentwood Waterproof Cushion Box — 350 L
description: Medium waterproof outdoor storage box from Keter, marketed under the Kentwood line. 350 litres of capacity (128 × 53.6 × 59 cm internal) in durable synthetic resin with a wood-grain finish. Lockable and weather-resistant, doubles as a bench seat for two adults (max 260 kg). On sale for 999 kr (save 200 kr).

title: Fie Parasol — ø 250 cm
description: Tilt-function garden parasol with an FSC-certified beech pole and 220 g/m² polyester canopy (ø 250 cm, height 235 cm). Pull-cord opening and reinforced rib mounting. Lightweight at just 5.8 kg. A perennial summer favourite at Europris, currently 999 kr (save 300 kr).

title: Miami Corner Sofa with Table — Aluminium
description: Outdoor corner sofa with matching table from the Miami series, built around a robust aluminium frame for low-maintenance year-round use. Generously padded cushions and a clean modern silhouette. The Miami series is one of Europris' most-searched garden lines this season.

title: Fyn Outdoor Sofa Set
description: Affordable outdoor sofa set from the Fyn line — great for smaller patios and balconies. Featured on Europris' "Summer mood at low prices" landing campaign at 1999 kr. Easy to stack and store away at the end of the season.

title: Marokko Bistro / Café Set — Steel
description: Two-chair bistro set with mosaic-tiled steel café table, inspired by Moroccan terrace design. Compact footprint makes it ideal for small balconies and patios. Currently 1259 kr at Europris (save 540 kr off 1799 kr).

title: Trampoline 3.6 m with Safety Net — Green
description: Round 3.6 m garden trampoline with included safety net, padding and ladder. Galvanised steel frame and high-tension springs for safe, predictable bounce. Comes with a 5-year warranty and is one of Europris' top-selling trampolines at 2499 kr.

title: Cuisine Blender — 1.75 L / 1200 W
description: Powerful 1200 W countertop blender with a 1.75 L jug — ideal for smoothies, soups, sauces and frozen drinks. Stainless steel blades and multiple speed settings handle ice and tough ingredients. A frequently restocked kitchen-electronics favourite at Europris.

title: Utepotte 30 cm — Green
description: Classic round outdoor pot in a fresh green glaze, 30 cm diameter. Frost-resistant stoneware with drainage hole. Perfect for seasonal flowers on the terrace or balcony.

title: Utepotte Capri — Beige
description: Lightweight Capri-style planter in warm beige. UV-stable plastic with a textured ceramic look. Ideal for herbs, small shrubs, or cascading flowers.

title: Utepotte Capri — Anthracite
description: Lightweight Capri-style planter in modern anthracite grey. UV-stable plastic with a textured ceramic look. Pairs well with green foliage and white flowers.

title: Utepotte Naturgra — Natural Grey
description: Medium outdoor pot in a natural grey stone finish. Fibre-reinforced composite that looks like concrete but weighs a fraction. Drainage hole included.

title: Utepotte Eden — Large Planter
description: Statement planter from the Eden range. Generous size suits small trees, large grasses, or multi-plant arrangements. Frost-resistant composite with elegant ribbed texture.

title: Plantejord 40 L — Blossom
description: General-purpose potting soil enriched with organic compost and perlite for optimal drainage. Suitable for flowers, vegetables, and container planting. 40-litre bag.

title: Blomsterjord 15 L — Nelson Garden
description: Premium indoor flower soil from Nelson Garden, with balanced nutrients for healthy houseplants. Fine-textured mix perfect for repotting tropical plants and flowering species. 15-litre bag.

title: Blomsterjord 40 L Peat-Free — Nelson Garden
description: Eco-friendly peat-free flower soil from Nelson Garden. Made with coconut coir and composted bark for sustainable gardening without compromising plant performance. 40-litre bag.

title: Lecakuler 15 L — Nelson Garden
description: Expanded clay pebbles (LECA) for drainage layers in pots and planters. Prevents waterlogging and root rot. Also useful as decorative top dressing or hydroponic substrate. 15-litre bag.

title: Lecakuler 40 L — Nelson Garden
description: Large bag of expanded clay pebbles (LECA) for serious gardeners. Perfect for lining the bottom of large planters, raised beds, or as standalone hydroponic media. 40-litre bag.

title: Plantenæring 1 L — Trim
description: Concentrated liquid plant food from Trim, suitable for all indoor and outdoor plants. Balanced NPK formula promotes lush foliage and abundant flowering. Dilute in water and apply every 1–2 weeks during the growing season.

title: Plantenæring 1 L — Substral
description: Premium liquid plant nutrition from Substral with added micronutrients and iron for deep green foliage. Suitable for all houseplants and balcony plants. Easy-dose cap for precise mixing.

title: Blåkorn 3.5 kg — Trim
description: Classic blue granular fertilizer (Blåkorn) for lawns, flower beds, and vegetable gardens. Slow-release NPK formula feeds plants for up to 3 months. Spread by hand or with a spreader. 3.5 kg bag covers approx. 100 m².

title: Næringspinne 40 stk — Giva
description: Slow-release feeding sticks for potted plants. Simply push into the soil near the roots for 2–3 months of continuous nutrition. Pack of 40 sticks — enough for 10–20 medium pots.

title: Gjødselspinner 30 stk Blomster — Substral
description: Substral fertilizer spikes formulated for flowering plants. Provides 2 months of balanced nutrition with extra phosphorus to promote blooms. Pack of 30 spikes.

title: Gjødselspinner 30 stk Grønne Planter — Substral
description: Substral fertilizer spikes for green foliage plants. Extra nitrogen promotes lush leaf growth. Push into the soil every 2 months during the growing season. Pack of 30 spikes.

title: Kugjødsel 40 L — Liv
description: Well-composted cow manure for enriching garden soil and potting mixes. Improves soil structure, water retention, and microbial activity. Use as a base layer or mix into existing soil. 40-litre bag.
